Long, voluminous platinum white hair with blunt-cut bangs and thick, fluffy textures. Large, sparkling sapphire blue eyes with a wide, innocent expression. Appears to be a youthful adolescent with a round, soft face. Slim, petite build. A futuristic white and gold combat uniform with a short pleated skirt, metallic armor plating on the shoulders and legs, and a small beret. Signature details include a small, fluffy white animal tail and matching fluffy animal ears atop the head.
